title: South32 sees limited risk of Indonesia replicating nickel success in alumina
body: South32 reported a 75% surge in full-year profit on Thursday, helped by strong performance at its alumina division and higher commodity prices.

title: Freeport Indonesia to wrap up Gresik plant repairs by early September
body: Freeport expects to complete early next month repair work at its JV smelter in East Java.

title: Indonesia scraps coal pricing rules after pushback from buyers
body: Miners will now be allowed to sell below government-set benchmarks.

title: Freeport Indonesia to ramp up concentrate exports ahead of ban
body: The firm has exported about 65% of the quota as of mid-August.

title: Nickel surpasses coal as Indonesia’s top export, Macquarie says
body: Earnings from overseas sales of nickel products were $16.5 billion in the first half of the year.

title: Indonesia mining ministry proposes 18 development projects for Danantara funding
body: Danantara is Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto's main vehicle to achieve his 8% economic growth target by 2029.

title: Vale Indonesia to seek up to $1.2 billion financing in 2026-2027
body: The first round of financing, around $500 million, will likely come from bank loans in early 2026.

title: Global Nickel Prices Remain Stable, Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate Sees Significant Increase
body: The Indonesia Nickel Price Index reported stable prices for most nickel products, with the exception of Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate, which saw a significant increase of $97 per metric ton to $12,883 per metric ton. The stability in nickel prices reflects a balance between global supply and demand, while the surge in MHP prices is driven by growing demand from the Asian battery industry for electric vehicles.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Industry Faces Trilemma in Implementing Environment, Social and Governance Standards
body: The Indonesian nickel industry is expected to face a trilemma of global demand, community price, and Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) standards, with companies such as PT Vale Indonesia and Ceria Corp already implementing ESG standards and remaining profitable. The industry is working towards a sustainable future, with a focus on research and development, human resource improvement, and collaboration between government, associations, and businesses to achieve a low-carbon footprint.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Sector Faces Challenges from Illegal Mining and Environmental Concerns
body: The Indonesian nickel mining sector is struggling with the issue of illegal mining, which is hindering the implementation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, with 11 community members currently imprisoned for protesting against illegal mining activities. The Indonesian Nickel Mining Association (APNI) is working to address these issues by synchronizing regulations with international ESG standards and promoting community involvement in policy-making to achieve a more sustainable and low-carbon nickel industry.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Holds Training to Miners 2025, Receives Positive Response from National Mining Industry Players
body: The Training to Miners (TTM) APNI 2025 event, held by the Indonesian Nickel Miners Association, provided valuable insights and updates on regulations and industry conditions, with participants hoping for more frequent and detailed information on these topics. The event highlighted the challenges faced by the mining sector, including increasing regulatory burdens and declining commodity prices, which are affecting profit margins and requiring companies to adapt to remain competitive.

title: Indonesian Mining Industry Faces Challenges Amid Global Dynamics, with Nickel and Coal Sectors Experiencing Significant Slowdown
body: The Indonesian mining industry, particularly the nickel and coal sectors, is currently experiencing a significant slowdown due to global price dynamics and geopolitical factors, with nickel reserves reaching 5.9 billion tons and annual production of 250 million tons. Despite the challenges, the gold sector is showing a positive trend, with profits reaching Rp5.1 trillion as of June 2025, and the industry is urged to enhance competencies and adapt to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) challenges to remain competitive.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Successfully Hosts Training to Miners 2025 Event
body: The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) successfully hosted the Training to Miners (TTM) APNI 2025 event from August 20-22, 2025, in Jakarta, aiming to enhance the capacity and understanding of nickel industry players in various strategic aspects of mining. The event covered nine key topics, including RKAB 1 Tahun, Kebijakan Kenaikan Upah Minimum, and Integrasi Prinsip ESG, with support from government institutions, sponsors, and industry players.

title: President Prabowo Subianto Vows to Crack Down on Illegal Mining, Estimating State Losses of at Least Rp300 Trillion
body: President Prabowo Subianto has announced plans to eradicate illegal mining practices in Indonesia, which have resulted in estimated state losses of at least Rp300 trillion, with 1,063 identified illegal mines and 163 of them potentially causing significant financial losses. The government aims to establish a legal framework for small-scale miners through cooperatives, while also taking a firm stance against large-scale illegal mining operations and related corruption.

title: Kementerian ESDM Tetapkan Harga Indeks Pasar Biodiesel untuk Periode September 2025 sebesar Rp 13.948 per liter
body: Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) menetapkan Harga Indeks Pasar (HIP) Bahan Bakar Nabati (BBN) jenis biodiesel untuk periode September 2025 sebesar Rp 13.948 per liter. Penetapan HIP ini didasarkan pada konversi Crude Palm Oil (CPO) menjadi biodiesel sebesar 85 USD/MT dan merupakan bagian dari implementasi Program Mandatori Biodiesel.

title: Nilai Ekonomi Karbon membuka peluang ekonomi baru bagi Indonesia dengan penerapan instrumen strategis untuk menginternalisasi biaya emisi gas rumah kaca ke dalam mekanisme pasar
body: Penerapan Nilai Ekonomi Karbon di Indonesia dapat meningkatkan efisiensi energi, mendorong adopsi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri Hijau, dan mempersiapkan industri menghadapi kebijakan internasional seperti Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism. Dengan demikian, Indonesia dapat membuka peluang ekonomi baru, termasuk pasar kredit karbon dan penguatan daya saing industri, serta meningkatkan ketahanan ekonomi rumah tangga terhadap fluktuasi harga energi di masa depan.

title: Vale Indonesia Commits to Sustainable Mining Practices and Environmental Conservation
body: Vale Indonesia has made significant progress in its sustainability efforts, having reclaimed 3,800 hectares of land in Sulawesi and planted 5 million trees, while also reducing its reliance on fossil fuels through the use of renewable energy sources, including three hydroelectric power plants with a total capacity of 365 MW. The company has also made strides in waste management, with 100% of its non-hazardous waste being utilized internally or externally, and has reduced its greenhouse gas emissions by 838,000 tons of CO₂ equivalent from 2022 to 2024.

title: MIND ID Strengthens Strategic Role in Building Sustainable Industrial Ecosystem through Mineral Hilirisasi
body: Holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia MIND ID is enhancing its strategic role in building a sustainable industrial ecosystem through the hilirisasi of minerals, particularly bauksit, which can increase its value from $40 to $2,800 after being processed into aluminium. Through its subsidiary PT Indonesia Asahan Aluminium (INALUM), MIND ID aims to fully utilize domestic alumina by 2025, supporting the national dekarbonization agenda and reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 3,700 tCO2e per year.

title: Pengeboran Sumur GGNB-S17 Menghasilkan Potensi Produksi Minyak dan Gas yang Signifikan
body: Pengeboran sumur GGNB-S17 yang dimulai pada 20 Agustus 2025 telah membuahkan hasil positif dengan potensi produksi sementara sebesar 776,16 barel minyak per hari dan 2,8 juta standar kaki kubik gas per hari. Uji produksi ini menunjukkan aliran hidrokarbon yang diperoleh secara natural dengan bean choke 64/64, menandakan prospek yang cerah untuk produksi minyak dan gas di lokasi ini.

title: Indonesia's mining and energy sector faces investment decline due to regulatory uncertainty and security concerns
body: The Indonesian government needs to create a conducive investment climate by simplifying and stabilizing regulations, ensuring fair law enforcement, and providing investment protection to attract investors in the energy and mineral sector. The lack of investment has resulted in the withdrawal of major companies such as Chevron, Shell, and ENI, leading to a decline in production, revenue, and job opportunities, ultimately affecting the country's economic growth.
